why: rc5 = rc4 fixes + /wowfa dump (all-class spell export) for the owner

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc5 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

New: /wowfa dump exports the live tooltip text of every spell in the game (all classes, ranks, talents, racials, professions) so the translation data covers every class, not one character. English text only, no account data.

Also in this build (from rc4): talent tooltips without spell data translate, female-character spell texts match, general / racial / profession spells have Persian, zone label self-feedback fixed, reasons shown on /wowfa > Status.

Data from ForeverDB.net
